desc:
🔥 UPDATE 2 IS OUT! Digging, weapons, global events and more!

💸 Ready to get RICH? Welcome to Make Slime To Get Rich!

🪣 Scoop glue from the pond and make your own slime.
🌈 Every batch is a mystery: Common, Epic, Legendary... or even COSMIC!
🤲 Squish it, stretch it and play with it!
📦 Stock the shelves and sell to customers, Rich Guys and celebrities!
🏏 Thieves are grabbing your slime! Bonk them with a bat before they get away!
🍳 Visit The Dealer across the road for frying pans, squeaky hammers and golden bats.
👷 Hire workers and grow a tiny shop into a giant Slime Factory.
🎉 Catch Slime Frenzies and server-wide events for huge boosts!
👫 Team up with up to 4 friends to pay back the businessmen.

Can YOU make $1,000,000,000? 💰🏆
👍 Like and favorite for more slime fun!
